title: Rust: Implement crash recovery for DAO routes
description: Part of DAO persistence crash safety (rpl)
close_reason:
Implemented crash recovery for DAO routes in Rust:

**Changes:**
- Added route state persistence types: PersistedCandidate, PersistedRouteEntry, DaoRouteState
- Added encode_route_state/decode_route_state functions for crash-safe persistence
- Added DaoRouteState with provision/open/update methods using redundant storage
- Added DaoManager.route_state_snapshot() to extract route state for persistence
- Added DaoManager.restore_route_state() to rebuild routes from persisted entries
- Added DaoManager.provision_root_with_routes() for initial provisioning with route state
- Added DaoManager.open_root_with_routes() for crash recovery with routes
- Added DaoManager.process_signature_verified_with_route_persistence() to persist routes atomically with replay floors

**Tests:**
- route_state_crash_recovery_roundtrip: Full crash recovery with DAO processing
- route_state_snapshot_and_restore: Direct snapshot/restore verification

**Files modified:**
- rust/lichen-rpl/src/persistence.rs
- rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs
